programs.name: Computer Science BSc (Hons)
programs.ib_offer: 37 points, with 766 in Higher Level subjects, including Mathematics
programs.ap_offer: A*AA equivalent: three APs at 5,5,5; or two APs at 5,5 plus one of SAT 1350 (minimum 700 Reading & Writing, 650 Maths), ACT 30, an Honours course at A+, or a one-year Dual Enrolment/College course at A. Exam scores must be submitted (course grades not accepted); any subject-specific requirement must be evidenced with an AP exam; AP Capstone not accepted. Programmes requiring A-level Mathematics need AP Calculus BC at grade 5.
programs.toefl_note: English language Band B. TOEFL iBT and Home Edition taken before 21 Jan 2026 (old 0-120 scale): 80 with no component under 20. Taken from 21 Jan 2026 (new 1-6 scale): 4.5 with no component under 4.
programs.english_note: Durham English language Band B (undergraduate): IELTS (UKVI/SELT or non-UKVI) 6.5 with no component under 6.0; PTE Academic 62 with no less than 59 in each communicative skill; Duolingo 120 overall and no less than 110 in each sub-score; Cambridge C1/C2 176 with 169 per component.
programs.notes: Contextual offer: AAB including A in Mathematics. No admissions test is listed on the course page. Start date September 2027; the page reflects Durham's 2027 course review. Fee: 'International (full-time): GBP 35,000 per year' on the course page for the September 2027 start. AP route: Durham's US-applicant table on the course page (same table on every course page, e.g. https://www.durham.ac.uk/study/courses/g400/). Where a school offers no AP curriculum, honours courses with GPA 3.7 can be used instead. English: all Durham undergraduate subjects in this set are Band B per https://www.durham.ac.uk/study/international/entry-requirements/english-language-requirements/english-language-levels-required/ ; Band B scores from https://www.durham.ac.uk/study/international/entry-requirements/english-language-requirements/direct-entry-band-b/.
